module origen_050199 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire Ta,
    input wire Tb,
    output reg green_a,
    output reg yellow_a,
    output reg red_a,
    output reg green_b,
    output reg yellow_b,
    output reg red_b
);

    // State encoding
    parameter S0 = 3'b000,
              S1 = 3'b001,
              S2 = 3'b010,
              S3 = 3'b011,
              S4 = 3'b100,
              S5 = 3'b101;

    reg [2:0] current_state, next_state;

    // State update block
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset)
            current_state <= S0;
        else
            current_state <= next_state;
    end

    // Next state and output logic block
    always @(*) begin
        // Default next state
        next_state = current_state;

        // Default output values
        green_a = 0; yellow_a = 0; red_a = 0;
        green_b = 0; yellow_b = 0; red_b = 0;

        case (current_state)
            S0: begin
                green_a = 1; red_b = 1;
                if (!Ta) next_state = S1;
            end
            S1: begin
                yellow_a = 1; red_b = 1;
                next_state = S2;
            end
            S2: begin
                red_a = 1; red_b = 1;
                next_state = S3;
            end
            S3: begin
                red_a = 1; green_b = 1;
                if (!Tb) next_state = S4;
            end
            S4: begin
                red_a = 1; yellow_b = 1;
                next_state = S5;
            end
            S5: begin
                red_a = 1; red_b = 1;
                next_state = S0;
            end
            default: next_state = S0;
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module tb_TLC;
    reg clk, reset, Ta, Tb;
    wire green_a, yellow_a, red_a, green_b, yellow_b, red_b;

    TLC uut (
        .clk(clk),
        .reset(reset),
        .Ta(Ta),
        .Tb(Tb),
        .green_a(green_a),
        .yellow_a(yellow_a),
        .red_a(red_a),
        .green_b(green_b),
        .yellow_b(yellow_b),
        .red_b(red_b)
    );

    // Clock generation
    initial begin
        clk = 0;
        forever #5 clk = ~clk;
    end

    // Test stimulus
    initial begin
        reset = 1;
        Ta = 1;
        Tb = 1;
        #10 reset = 0;
        #100 Ta = 0;
        #50 Ta = 1;
        #100 Tb = 0;
        #50 Tb = 1;
        #100 $finish;
    end

    // Monitor
    initial begin
        $monitor("Time=%0t, State=%b, Ta=%b, Tb=%b, Lights: A(%b%b%b), B(%b%b%b)",
                 $time, uut.current_state, Ta, Tb, green_a, yellow_a, red_a, green_b, yellow_b, red_b);
    end

endmodule
